additional.name: JobCity
additional.overview: A 3D job-search tracker with listings collected from public job feeds.
highlights: Built a 3D interface for exploring jobs and tracking applications, backed by FastAPI and MongoDB.
Added ingestion adapters for five ATS sources and normalized their listings. Added tests for access rules, job filters, and ingestion, with CI for tests and container builds.

additional.name: Food Sage
additional.overview: A team project that extracts ingredients from photos of food labels.
highlights: Worked on image preprocessing and OCR to locate ingredient lists and extract their text.
Won the Visual AI Hackathon with the Food Sage team at Arizona State University.
